- [EVENT] User is planning a 4-day trip to Colorado in July.
- [FACT] User has previously packed 7 tops for a 5-day trip to California in February.
- [PREFERENCE] User prefers packing clothes that can be easily mixed and matched.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Colorado in July usually has warm weather with low humidity, perfect for outdoor activities.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Daytime temperatures in lower elevations (like Denver and Colorado Springs) usually range from mid-80s to low 90s Fahrenheit (29-32°C).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Nighttime temperatures in Colorado can dip to mid-50s to low 60s Fahrenheit (13-18°C).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Mountainous areas in Colorado have highs in the 70s and 80s Fahrenheit (21-27°C) and lows in the 50s and 60s Fahrenheit (10-21°C).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] July is relatively dry in Colorado, with an average of 2-3 inches (51-76 mm) of precipitation.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Afternoon thunderstorms are common in the mountains but are usually brief and followed by sunshine.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Colorado has an average of 300 days of sunshine per year.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should pack lightweight, breathable clothing, comfortable hiking shoes, lightweight pants, swimwear, a rain jacket, sunscreen, sunglasses, a hat, and a water bottle or hydration pack.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should check the weather forecast before the trip.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To avoid overpacking, user should start with a color scheme, choose multi-purpose items, pack layers, select versatile tops and bottoms, limit shoes, and roll clothes to save space.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should aim for a ratio of 3:2:1 for tops to bottoms and edit their selection after packing.
- [PREFERENCE] User has been guilty of overpacking in the past, especially with tops.
- [EVENT] User remembers packing 7 tops for a 5-day trip to California, wearing only 3 of them.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Packing a portable power bank is a good idea for the trip to Colorado.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A portable power bank can help keep devices charged during long days outdoors and when access to power outlets is limited.
